NVIDIA’s latest GPUs are here, and whatever you think about them, the combination of DLSS, Reflex, frame generation and more makes them impressively capable.
 Read more
articles.title: Alienware price crash sale lands RTX 5070 Ti rig at just $1750, it's first time ever this low

articles.author: Edwin Evans-Thirlwell
articles.description:
Early in my hands-on for End Of Abyss, the developer sitting next to me expressed surprise at how readily and consistently I was using the game's handheld scanner. I myself was surprised - perhaps even appalled - to hear that other journalists had been neglecting it.
End Of Abyss, you see, takes place in an underground plate-metal labyrinth where every corner is a huddle of waiting shadows, every doorway a mystery, and every ventilation fan a web of fungal grot. I hate to cast aspersions on other members of the press, but you would have to be an absolute chowderhead to explore such a warren using your eyes alone. This is a world that feels like it's holding its breath.
 Read more
articles.title: End Of Abyss is a Dark Soulsy shooter spawned from the bowels of Little Nightmares

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jiří Sluka)
articles.description: Pravidelná sonda do světa software. Podíváme se na nástroj pro mazání dočasných souborů, budeme zálohovat git repozitáře a nakonec si namountujeme a zanalyzujeme diskové obrazy.
articles.title: Softwarová sklizeň (25. 6. 2025): promažte z disku dočasné soubory

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Pavel Tišnovský)
articles.description: Jednou z vlastností platformy IBM PC byl naprostý chaos vládnoucí grafickém subsystému. Existuje zde však stabilní prvek: textové režimy. Dnes si řekneme, jak se možnosti rozšířily s příchodem karet SVGA.
articles.title: Textové režimy grafických karet SVGA na platformě IBM PC

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Redakce)
articles.description: Běží to již nějakou dobu a poběží to podle současných podmínek už jen do konce roku 2025. O čem je řeč? No přece o 50tisícové dotaci na vzdělání pro každého českého občana.
articles.title: 50 000 Kč jen pro vás na školení v našich kurzech

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: ČD - Telematika)
articles.description: Podíváme se na phishingovou kampaň Silver Fox APT cílenou na Tchaj-wan, prozkoumáme kritickou RCE zranitelnost ve Veeam Backup & Replication a odhalíme, jak funkce ASP v Gmailu umožnila obejít vícefaktorové ověření.
articles.title: Postřehy z bezpečnosti: Írán se brání kyberútokům, zpomaluje síťový provoz

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Filip Zatloukal)
articles.description: Linuxová distribuce Nitrux opouští KDE Plasma, ukončuje vývoj vlastního prostřední a přechází na Hyprland. EndBOX je vestavěné výpočetní zařízení, které používá NetBSD k přímému spuštění prostředí BASIC.
articles.title: EndBOX nabízí BASIC jako za starých časů, Nitrux přechází na Hyprland

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Týden v KDE o Plasmě 6.4 a opravách UI, GNOME vypichující aplikaci pro filmové fotografy, XLibre 25.0 jako první zkušební vydání po oddělení od X.Org Serveru, Fwupd 2.0.12 s podporou pro Intel Battlemage.
articles.title: Oprava pro Sound Blaster AWE32, první vydání XLibre 25.0

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Před dvěma týdny se výrazně rozšířily zprávy o novém forku X.Org Serveru, který chce řešit jeho neduhy. Zapamatujme si jméno Enrico Weigelt, asi o něm ještě uslyšíme.
articles.title: XLibre jako další bouře ve sklenici vody, nebo spása pro X.Org?

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Pavel Tišnovský)
articles.description: Už jsme se seznámili s tím, jak zjistit informace o režimech SVGA karet přes VBE a jak se přistupuje do video paměti. Právě zde dochází k problémům, které je nutné řešit. Týká se to i operace typu BitBLT pro přenos rastrových obrázků.
articles.title: Od grafické karty VGA k vyšším rozlišením i většímu množství barev (3. část)

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Petr Krčmář)
articles.description: Minulý týden postihl služby společnosti Google další velký výpadek. Opět se ukázalo, že služby využívající decentralizovanou internetovou síť stejně nakonec závisejí na dalších službách. Proč k výpadku došlo?
articles.title: Výpadek služeb Google způsobil chybný kód, efekt stáda pak přetížil systémy

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Filip Zatloukal)
articles.description: Sonda do světa otevřeného softwaru. Dnes si řekneme o nástroji pro sledování činností, vyzkoušíme si aplikaci pro poslech podcastů, přejmenujeme si obrazové soubory a podíváme se na prohlížeč 2D dat.
articles.title: Softwarová sklizeň (18. 6. 2025): sledujte své činnosti nejen u počítače

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Jednou z věcí pro budoucí Fedoru 43, o které se bude v rámci FESCo rozhodovat, je přechod od X.Org Serveru k XLibre Serveru. Alespoň toto navrhuje zvážit Kevin Kofler. Návrhy lze vznést různé, vzpomeňme třeba 12 let starý prank na Michaela Larabela, neznamená to, že by reálně hrozilo, že Fedora přejde na XLibre. Zvláště s ohledem na fakt, že vlastní Fedora s GNOME v této době X11 opouští zcela.
articles.title: Rozhodování Fedory o případném přechodu z X.Org na XLibre

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Redakce)
articles.description: Zajímá vás moderní přístup ke službám a témata jako Docker, kontejnery, cloud, virtualizace a Kubernetes? Připravili jsme pro vás čtyřdenní kurz Docker s Kubernetes, na který můžete získat dotaci až 82 % od Úřadu práce. Kontaktujte naši kolegyni pavla.hettnerova@iinfo.cz.
articles.title: Čtyřdenní kurz Docker s Kubernetes dotovaný Úřadem práce

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Český rozhlas informuje o výsledku soudního sporu, který vedl jeho novinář Jan Cibulka s Ministerstvem průmyslu a obchodu ve věci shromažďování dat z mobilních telefonů, konkrétně „zákonnou povinnost telekomunikačních firem, například mobilních operátorů, shromažďovat a uchovávat o svých uživatelích provozní a lokalizační údaje“. Jan Cibulka vyhrál, průmini podá odvolání.
articles.title: Stát nutí operátory k přílišnému sběru dat uživatelů, rozhodl soud

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Nová verze 5.2 nástroje Darktable přináší možnost porovnání dvou snímků vedle sebe, namísto dosavadního překryvu. V panelech pak lze volně zoomovat / posouvat, za stisku klávesy a (bez ní proběhne rotace). Modul metadata je nyní plně konfigurovatelný a umožňuje vložit a uchovávat libovolný tag, který je podporován v exiv2.
articles.title: Darktable 5.2 s modulem Sigmoid jako výchozím

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Stabilní vydání GIMPu 3.0 je úspěšně za námi, včetně prvních opravných verzí 3.0.2 a 3.0.4, a tak je čas se posunout dál. Vývojáři vydali první zkušební verzi nové vývojové řady 3.1, ze které jednoho dne (doufejme, že v nepříliš vzdálené budoucnosti) vzejde GIMP 3.2 – co pro ni tvůrci chystají, shrnuje přehled na domovském webu projektu, případně přehled na GitLabu.
articles.title: GIMP 3.1.2, první vývojová verze na cestě ke GIMPu 3.2

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: David Ježek)
articles.description: Jednou z novinek, kterými čerstvé vydání prohlížeče Firefox 140 zpříjemní život spoustě uživatelů, je možnost uvolnění obsahu otevřených panelů („Unload Tab“). Deaktivovat načtení panelu lze pro jeden či klidně pro všechny, resp. výběr panelů. Na Androidu pak Firefox 140 přichází s možností výběru všech panelů, která na této platformě dosud chyběla.
articles.title: Firefox 140 přináší snadnou deaktivaci panelů, služba Pocket skončila

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Vilém Sládek)
articles.description: Na webu konference Den IPv6 2025, která se konala 6. června v Národní technické knihovně v pražských Dejvicích, jsou nyní k dispozici všechny prezentace (v PDF) a jejich videozáznamy.
articles.title: Přednášky a videa z Dne IPv6 2025 jsou na webu konference

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Firma RedMonk vytváří žebříček programovacích jazyků každoročně od roku 2012. Žebříček se vytváří podle PR ve veřejných repozitářích na GitHubu bez započtení forků a také podle počtu dotazů na StackOverflow. Tato metodika může některým jazykům přidávat a jiným ubírat. Výhodou je, že postup je stejný od roku 2012.
articles.title: Žebříček programovacích jazyků RedMonk: JS, Python a Java

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: johny)
articles.description: Windsurf, popredný AI-native editor pre vývojárov, predstavil novú verziu svojho IDE, ktorá prináša vstavaný prehliadač založený na Chromiu. Novinka umožňuje vývojárom priamo v prostredí editora Windsurf otvárať webové stránky, sledovať konzolu, DOM či obsah stránok a využívať tieto dáta ako kontext pre AI asistenta Cascade.
articles.title: Windsurf prináša vstavaný prehliadač založený na Chromiu

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Cloudflare minulý týden ve čtvrtek zveřejnilo detaily rekordního DDoS útoku na jednoho svého nejmenovaného klienta, který používá službu Magic Transit k ochraně před útoky. K útoku došlo v polovině května a dosáhl rychlosti 7,3 Tb/s.
articles.title: Rekordní DDoS útok měl 7,3 Tb/s

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Mark Russinovich, kterého patrně znáte jako zakladatele Sysinternals, pozval v sobotu na večeři Linuse Torvaldse, Billa Gatese a Dave Cutlera (vývojář VMS a Windows NT).
articles.title: Historicky první fotografie Linuse Torvaldse s Billem Gatesem

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Vývojáři Intelu a Ubuntu si všimli, že vypnutí opravy Spectre v balíku intel-compute-runtime vede k zvýšení výkonu v OpenCL asi o 20 %. Navíc Spectre je ve výchozím stavu opraven v linuxovém jádře, takže teoreticky by zranitelné byly pouze OpenCL úlohy a na ty zatím neexistuje žádný známý útok.
articles.title: Vypnutí bezpečnostních oprav u GPU Intel vede k 20% nárůstu výkonu

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Redakce)
articles.description: Provozujete vlastní infrastrukturu a chcete vědět, v jakém stavu se v každém okamžiku nachází? Zabbix vám umožní monitorovat infrastrukturu z pohledu sítí, tak i z pohledu operačních systémů až po aplikace. Přináší ucelené monitorovací řešení. Naučíme vás konfigurovat monitorovací systém Zabbix od základních kroků až po složité nízkoúrovňové objevování monitorovaných objektů.
articles.title: Zabbix: monitorujte svou infrastrukturu a mějte ji pod kontrolou (školení)

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Před měsícem bylo oznámeno, že Microsoft WSL (Windows subsystem for Linux) bude open source pod licencí MIT. Dnes vyšla první open source verze 2.6.0.
articles.title: Vyšlo WSL 2.6.0, poprvé jako open source

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Podle nařízení Evropské komise mají mít ode dneška všechny prodávané mobilní telefony a tablety povinné označení energetickým štítkem, který známe například u televizorů, praček a ledniček. Kromě energetické náročnosti A-G (A nejlepší, G nejhorší) je zde uvedena doba chodu na jedno nabití, odolnost proti pádu (A-E), počet cyklů, které baterie vydrží, index opravitelnosti (A-E) a stupeň krytí IP.
articles.title: V EU mají odedneška mít prodávané mobilní telefony a tablety energetické štítky

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Jan Fikar)
articles.description: Londýnský Pinefeat dodává adaptér pro kameru Raspberry Pi HQ (12 Mpix), který umožňuje použít objektivy Canon EF/EF-S. A to včetně automatického ostření a ovládání clony. Kromě toho mají také Canon EF/EF-S adaptér pro kameru Arducam IMX708 (12 Mpix).
articles.title: Kamera Raspberry Pi HQ má adaptér pro objektivy Canon EF/EF-S

articles.author: redakce@root.cz (Root.cz: Redakce)
articles.description: Proxmox je moderní virtualizační platforma, která v mnoha případech může nahradit VMware. articles.author: Adam Newell
articles.description:
Destructoid, I have gone down a rabbit hole I can't bring myself out of, and I'm writing this article in hopes others can join me. As I can't stop watching how insane some Mario Kart World tricks are, mere weeks after release.


Most videos of people competing for world record speed times on tracks appear innocent enough at first. A few tricks here and there, some good Mushroom usage, and then suddenly a player is launching themselves off a map to get speed boosts of a single pixel of a tree or go to areas of the stage that feel out of bounds but actually aren't.




Take, for example, Great ? Block Ruins where, near the end of the map, the player does a leap of faith into a pit, tricks off a lone tree onto a wall, and then hits a cloud to jump back onto the stage, essentially riding beneath the track but coming out of it fine. It's one of many examples where players have been able to create impossible jumps.




There are also tracks like Faraway Oasis that take advantage of weird water mechanics to launch racers into the air to get on platforms and places they wouldn't usually be able to, while still finding time to do a trick off a beam or something you wouldn't even consider accessible. 




There's even a bigger shock when, in stages like DK Spaceport, you find out it's actually faster to not do any tricks at all and go in a straight line rather than wall riding off platforms or doing small jump dashes. Every second adds up, so after seeing some of the wilder tricks on other stages before, realizing sometimes it's quicker to do 0 tricks becomes equally baffling.


These are just some of the many tricks and tracks I have been scrolling on YouTube shorts or in my spare time, and it makes me wonder what else players will discover as the game gets optimized over time. Also, what is your favorite track or trick you've seen so far!? Let me know in the comments below!

The post Have you seen the wild tricks Mario Kart World players are pulling off!? appeared first on Destructoid.

Rock-climbing co-op title PEAK has been one of the biggest sleeper hits of 2025, and many have been searching their console stores to find the game.


However, PEAK is only available on a PC. It's exclusively available on Steam and at a very modest price, to say the least. However, what about the future? Could this entertaining game arrive on consoles in the future? Let's find out.


Will PEAK be released on the Xbox Series X|S and the PS5?


As of this writing, it's highly unlikely that PEAK will ever become available on Xbox and PlayStation consoles. But if we check out the official FAQ from the developers, there is a slight ray of hope.



At the moment we’re only supporting Windows PC’s for the game, in the future we might decide to support more platforms.




However, there's also this piece of info from the same FAQ. 



At the moment we don't have any plans for PEAK updates past this point. The Landcrab team were super happy to make this lil scout game together but both Aggro Crab and Landfall have other projects ahead of them that they want to focus on for the future."






Things certainly could change for the developers and their plans after the resounding success on PC. More than a million copies have been sold on the platform alone, so there's definitely good incentive for Landcrab to invest in a console port. The controls and mechanics of the game also make it pretty feasible for you to play with a controller if required.


That said, I will still consider a console port to be unlikely, since they involve plenty of costs.


Is PEAK available on mobile devices?


If the chances of PEAK coming to console are low, it's next to nothing on mobile. If you find anything similar on either your Google Play Store or the iOS App Store, chances are that they're fake. Those games aren't associated with Landcrab at all, and hence, you should refrain from using them.

PEAK has been out for nearly a week now, and as millions of us have picked up the game, I'm curious to know just how many players have managed to reach the top of the mountain, and who is still searching for their first win.


Whether it's as a solo player or as a part of a team, the game is tough to complete, with a different island spawning every day. I have managed to beat it solo, albeit by getting very lucky with my item and equipment drops, including a couple of chain cannons to help me get across the inside of the mountain, but have yet to beat the game on anything other than Tenderfoot difficulty due to a lack of friends to play it with.


The starting area is my go to for finding the best items due to the abundance of luggage creates and is always easy to get through, its only when i hit the jungle as a solo player, do I start to find issues, and don't even get me started on the blizzards in the third area. These are where I usually lose my solo runs, either through getting heavily poisoned or attacked by bees, or failing to account for frost damage at the worst possible time when climbing a glacier. 


On the few attempts I reach the volcano, I seem to have a better time here as it's more about patience than danger, plotting your route by seeing where things are interconnected and waiting for the lava to be at the lowest point to make a run. So long as you don't have to rush, it's fairly easy to get through. 


Climbing the inside of the volcano, though, is by far the toughest part, especially with how few climbable areas there are or places to hold onto. It really feels like you need to use equipment here only when absolutely necessary to reach the peak and get out.


But enough waffling about my solo problems. How have you all been faring in PEAK so far?

A variety of items in the new co-op climbing indie game can help you reach the mountaintop (or peak, so to speak), such as ropes, food to keep you energized, or a compass to give you a nudge in the right direction.


The Pirate's Compass is one of these items, and it's a good one to take with you if you ever come across it in your journey to the peak, whether in solo play or co-op play with friends. But first, you need to find it.

What is Pirate's Compass in PEAK?


Screenshot by Destructoid


Pirate's Compass is a special item you can find in PEAK that will point you in the direction of the nearest closed luggage bag, which contains loot inside for you to use on your expedition up the mountain.


This is a super useful item since it makes searching for luggage bags and their corresponding loot very easy, so if you need to find items like food or any other useful resources, the Pirate's Compass will show you the way. If you find it while scavenging, pick it up to use it and keep on looting to increase your chances of reaching the peak.


How to get Pirate's Compass in PEAK


Pirate's Compass is a rare spawn item that can be found within luggage on the map. This means that you need to get lucky with luggage to find it, and then it will help you find more luggage, so you definitely need some good fortune.


Since it's an item that spawns rarely because it's so useful, make sure you or a friend picks it up and uses it whenever you find it.

Ireland's Data Protection Commission (DPC) says it has been "engaging with Sky for some time" over the use of personal data to crackdown on streaming piracy, including IPTV services accessed via set-top boxes. Ongoing engagement and a meeting between the DPC and Sky in two weeks time, will focus on the lawful sharing or processing of personal data outside the company under the GDPR.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Sky Views Personal Data as a Potential Weapon in IPTV Piracy War

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Despite blocking thousands of illegal streaming sites and services, Italy's new anti-piracy law and the related 'Piracy Shield' blocking system have a limited effect on piracy rates. Meanwhile, new data shows that the damages suffered by sports rightsholders continue to soar. On the positive side, public awareness of the new anti-piracy law is widespread.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Sports Piracy Damages Soar in Italy Despite ‘Piracy Shield’ Blocking Efforts

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
Authorities in Greece are making good on their promise to crack down and deter use of pirate sites and services. Arrests during a significant action to disrupt pirate IPTV last month are now followed by news of an immediate five-year prison sentence and a €10,000 fine. The 59-year-old defendant was reportedly found guilty of running a private torrent site; P2Planet.net. Curiously, the site announced its closure over a decade ago, making the offenses even older than that.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: BitTorrent Pirate Gets 5 Years in Prison, €10,000 Fine, For Decade-Old Offenses

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
After two years of litigation, X Corp. and leading music publishers are eyeing a settlement in their copyright infringement dispute. The move follows X Corp.'s recent "maximum pain" allegations against the NMPA, suggesting the lawsuit aimed to force licensing agreements. A 90-day case stay has been approved to allow both sides to amicably resolve their disagreements.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: X vs. Music Publishers: Settlement Looms in Copyright Clash After “Maximum Pain” Revelation

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
Italian telecoms regulator AGCOM has regularly criticized Google over its anti-piracy efforts, but the signs suggest that change is on the way. AGCOM says a system activated last month, relayed blocking orders received by the Piracy Shield anti-piracy system, directly to Google, which "promptly" blocked pirate site domains on its public DNS resolver. AGCOM says the system should be fully operational "as soon as possible" but warns that Google will still have to do more.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Google Receives Piracy Shield Orders to Block Pirate Sites in Public DNS

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Napster, the brand synonymous with the music piracy boom of the early 2000s, has a new copyright challenge. Together with audio giant Sonos, Napster faces a lawsuit demanding over $3.4 million in alleged unpaid copyright royalties. Filed by SoundExchange, the complaint centers on missed payments related to the "Sonos Radio" service, which until 2023 was powered by Napster's music catalog.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Napster and Sonos Sued for Millions in Unpaid Music Royalties

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
A five-year-old investigation by US-based streaming service YuppTV features in a copyright complaint filed at a federal court in Pennsylvania. Alleging systematic piracy of YuppTV  content, the complaint claims to identify the owner of various IPTV services and companies, collectively the 'Boss IPTV Cartel'. Allegations against CDN company Datacamp, set-top box manufacturer Infomir, and other intermediaries, add extra layers to an already complicated case.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: IPTV Piracy Lawsuit Targets ‘Boss IPTV Cartel’, CDN, Hosts, Set-Top Box Supplier

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
The High Court in New Delhi, India, has granted a new type of pirate site blocking order, dubbed the "superlative" injunction. The blocking order was obtained by Star India, a subsidiary of American entertainment giant Disney. It aims to disrupt IPTV Smarters Pro and related pirate sites and apps in 'real-time', with a temporary carte blanche to add new targets. 
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: The ‘Superlative’ Injunction: India’s Pirate Site Blockades Go Next Level

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
Sports rightsholders have revised their calls for illegal streams to be taken down inside 30 mins. It must now happen much more quickly, with the word 'immediately' given the thumbs up. How much of this additional pressure is bargaining strategy isn't clear, but in site-blocking countries like Italy, the UK, and Canada, detecting pirate infrastructure isn't a last minute effort. Many targets earmarked for blocking are identified not just hours in advance, but in some cases days earlier.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: ‘Immediate’ Pirate IPTV Shutdowns? No Problem, Please Ask Us Yesterday

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
A group of major record labels has fired back at an amicus brief from the U.S. Solicitor General, which urges the Supreme Court to accept Cox Communications' petition in a landmark piracy liability lawsuit. The labels characterize the Solicitor General's recommendation to back Cox's petition while denying their own as 'bewildering'.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Record Labels Rebuff U.S. Government in Landmark ISP Piracy Liability Showdown

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
The French Senate has passed a new anti-piracy bill that opens the door to automated IP-address blocking. This legislative push is bolstered by a parallel, "secret" agreement between sports rightsholders and major ISPs, which aims to automate anti-piracy efforts and streamline direct blocking requests. Rightsholders hope these new powers will help to tackle the "mafia-like" piracy economy.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: France Escalates War on Sports Piracy with Real-Time IP Blocking

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
Earlier this week, Japanese manga publisher Shueisha filed a DMCA subpoena application in the U.S., as it continues to pursue the operators of major pirate sites. At the very top of Shueisha's latest list is Mangajikan, a site that appears to have received 185 million visitors in May alone. In Japan, that made Mangajikan more popular than Instagram, Facebook, and ChatGPT. But right now, on what used to be its front page, is a very clear message: Website Closed.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Piracy Giant Mangajikan’s “Website Closed” After 185m Visits in May Alone

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Internet providers are increasingly tasked in the role of anti-piracy enforcers and instructed to block pirate websites and services. In Europe, court-ordered blockades are now commonplace, but ISPs are cautious when it comes to further expansion. In a recent submission to the EU Commission, EuroISPA, which represents over 3,300 ISPs, complains about "disproportionate" blocking measures, as recently seen in Italy, Spain and elsewhere.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: European ISPs Complain About ‘Disproportionate’ Pirate Site Blocking

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
When platforms like Facebook and YouTube receive takedown notices from a reputable sender, Japan's CODA for example, the vast majority of requests are usually honored. Yet, the responses from obvious pirate sites and more legally ambiguous platforms couldn't be more varied. Some refuse to act, period. Others have compliance rates higher than Facebook, YouTube, or TikTok.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Pirate Sites’ Takedown Compliance Beats YouTube, Facebook, TikTok

articles.author: Ernesto Van der Sar
articles.description:
Fresh data for 2024 reveals that while overall pirate site traffic dipped to 216 billion visits, the landscape is shifting dramatically. Publishing piracy is booming, largely driven by an insatiable global demand for manga. In stark contrast, both music and film piracy have tanked. Despite these changes, the United States remains the top traffic source for pirate sites.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: Pirate Site Visits Dip to 216 Billion a Year, But Manga Piracy is Booming

articles.author: Andy Maxwell
articles.description:
ICANN, the organization responsible for ensuring the stability of the internet's Domain Name System (DNS), has published advice for all entities involved in DNS blocking.  Three key recommendations arrive  as part of a comprehensive report from ICANN's Security and Stability Advisory Committee (SSAC) on the technical means of DNS blocking and its effects - both intended and unintended.
From: TF, for the latest news on copyright battles, piracy and more.
articles.title: ICANN’s DNS Blocking Report Presents Three Key Recommendations

articles.author: nospam@scummvm.org (Bosca)
articles.description:
Paris, July 24, 1914. We are excited to announce that Jordan Mechner's acclaimed real-time adventure The Last Express is now ready for testing in ScummVM!
Step into the shoes of Robert Cath, an American doctor on the run from murder charges, as he boards the legendary Orient Express for what would be its final journey before the outbreak of World War I.
What makes this adventure game truly unique is its time-based gameplay - the game takes place in real time, and characters move within the train following their own schedules, speaking in their native languages, and living their lives whether you're watching or not. But don't worry... you can always rewind time if you missed anything important!
To test this game, you'll need the original version of the game (either from the original hybrid DOS/Windows/Mac CDs or from GOG.com) and a daily development build of ScummVM. Please note that the Gold Edition available from Steam is NOT supported - only the original version is compatible at this time. The engine supports the following languages for the game: English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish. We couldn't locate the Japanese version at the moment, but please contact us if you have it!
Grab a daily build, have our testing guidelines handy, and get ready for an incredible journey through history, mystery, and one of the most innovative adventure games of the 1990s — and besides... the Orient Express is such a beautiful train, wouldn't you want to take some screenshots while you're there?
>
articles.title: All aboard! The Last Express is ready for testing!

articles.author: nospam@scummvm.org (DreamMaster)
articles.description:
A young physics professor named Lester conducts a particle experiment. Suddenly, something goes wrong, lightning strikes, and in a moment Lester finds himself in a strange alien world. Now he must fight for his life in this strange place. Luckily, he'll find help along the way..
The ScummVM Team is pleased to announce full support for Out of this World (aka Another World). This is particularly noteworthy, since the original version of this engine was briefly added to ScummVM over twenty years ago. 
Help us test the game by grabbing a daily build. Read through our testing guidelines. Currently, only the original DOS and Windows 3.1 versions are supported, though with sounds effects only, and not the music. Also, unfortunately, the Anniversary Editions are not yet supported. Additionally, like the original, you can't save your game, but you can use the 'c' key to open an area select dialog to enter a code to resume where you left off. And please take some screenshots along the way.
Lester's fate is in your hands. You'll deal with dangerous fauna, bloodthirsty aliens, and fiendish puzzles as you flee for your life.
>
articles.title: A whole new world. A new fantastic point of view.

articles.author: nospam@scummvm.org (Alikhan)

(Tento post není o filmu)
Znáte jistě Kafkův "Proces", Adamsova "Stopařova průvodce po galaxii" nebo Gilliamův film Brazil. Téma rozbujelé byrokracie, která komplikuje řešení čehokoliv, je velmi vděčné. Ale dnes, kdy se tyto procesy přenesly do online chatů, kde jsou aktivně rozdmýchávány za pomoci AI chatbotů a cizinců, kteří se s vámi baví pomocí strojového překladače (používajícího česká slova "Áno" a "Ďekujeme"), bylo dosaženo dokonalosti.
Včera jsme si koupili vysavač Dyson a zodpovědně jsem se ho pokusil zaregistrovat na oficiálních stránkách, jak mě důrazně upozorňoval přiložený leták se sériovým kódem výrobku. Což nešlo, protože stránka hlásila, že "tento kód není validní". Klikl jsem tudíž na "WhatsApp chat s naší podporou" a započal úžasný příběh:

Sérii screenshotů nutno rozkliknout, případně kliknout sem pro velkou verzi.
Pointa: Podařilo se mi nakonec sehnat lokální české telefonní číslo Dysonu a tam mi řekli, že vysavač nikde registrovat nemusím a v případě reklamace mi stačí faktura od Alzy.
